notice: Published figure digitization; these are NOT raw experimental records.

grift2019.steady_depth_assignment: Marker/grid systematic offset ~0.24 mm. Model groups nearest integer-mm nominal depths, tolerance 0.5 mm. Extracted CSV retains original vector coordinates.
grift2019.limitations: Vector curve is already filtered/decimated in publication. Quantization bounds are not experimental uncertainty. Digitization cannot recover sensor sampling or covariance.

day2011.limitations: Different hull from repository. Orange free-transition diamonds only. Pixel calibration at 150 dpi; approximate +/-2 pixels, not original measurement error.
